claim: v3 detecting-insults with haiku on 8 roles + sonnet ONLY on designer also does NOT fix the malformed-submission failure that X202 (haiku-everywhere) and X209 (aggregator=sonnet only) exhibited. Pipeline runs to completion at $3.99 total, but the submission.csv lacks the 'Comment' column. Medal=none (invalid_submission). The schema gate is therefore NOT designer either. By elimination, coder is the next-most-likely schema-defining role on the v3 text-classification path. X218 (coder=sonnet) is the next isolation experiment.

support.grader_error: Submission should have an Comment column

scope: Single Phase 2 run. Three consecutive runs on detecting-insults (X202 haiku-all, X209 sonnet-agg-only, X217 sonnet-designer-only) all produce the same invalid_submission. Designer is ruled out as the schema gate.

vs_x209.verdict: Nearly identical total cost; nearly identical sonnet-role cost ($0.27 for sonnet-aggregator vs $0.44 for sonnet-designer). Neither role lift fixed the schema.

limitations: coder is the remaining single-role candidate. X218 will isolate it.

implications.schema_gate_localization: Designer ruled out. Coder is the most likely remaining single-role candidate (writes inference.py / submission.csv generation). If X218 (coder=sonnet) also fails, the gate is multi-role and the cost-savings hypothesis on detecting (sonnet-only-on-N-roles, rest haiku) cannot be realized.
